reasoning_content:
The VPS WorldTick already has the .chunks fix applied! So that was from my local upload. But it's still crashing on getActiveChunks not being a function. The issue is the VPS chunkSystem doesn't have that method.

Let me check what methods chunkSystem actually has:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check chunk system methods
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'getActiveChunks\\|getChunk\\|setChunkActive' /opt/areloria/server/src/systems/ChunkSystem.ts 2>&1 | head -10")
print("Methods:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
